summary.overview: The project has strong task guidance, a multi-layer CI quality gate, and a documented delivery acceptance route with recovery owner. The main gap is that the documented ship-loop verification commands are not registered as executable npm scripts, breaking the goal-driven workflow agents are told to follow. Learning capture infrastructure exists but has no exercised evidence.

suggestions.title: Exercise the configured ship-loop Skill on the next bounded feature
suggestions.reason: The ship-loop Skill defines a complete RPI workflow, but no session evidence shows it being used end-to-end. Once its commands are registered, one bounded exercise would confirm the loop works.
suggestions.nextStep: After registering the missing npm scripts, run one non-trivial task through goal start, research, plan, implement, goal:verify, and done.
suggestions.validation: Confirm goal:verify passes and the goal completes without manual workarounds.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: Rich agent guidance (AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, STACK.md, DEPLOYMENT.md) provides clear intent, context routes, and scope boundaries for common tasks.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Basic startup is reproducible (Node 24 pin, lockfile, npm ci), but the documented ship-loop commands (goal, goal:verify, ship:eval) are not registered in package.json, blocking the primary agent verification workflow.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: CI runs lint, typecheck, tests, and build with uploaded diagnostics on failure. Local npm test and npm run lint are available. No session evidence of exercised validation-after-edit.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Release workflow gates production on quality plus a recorded acceptance decision artifact. Recovery route is documented with a named owner, specific commands, and a 15-minute SLA.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: Learning-loop scripts and a ship-loop Skill exist, but zero episode records, zero normalized events, and no later comparison window have been observed.

findings.title: Documented ship-loop verification commands are not registered as npm scripts
findings.reason: AGENTS.md and the ship-loop Skill instruct agents to run npm run goal, goal:verify, ship:eval, ship:improve, host:compile, and graph:query. None of these are registered in package.json. The underlying script files exist (scripts/goal.mjs, scripts/ship-eval.mjs) but are not wired as executable commands, so agents following the documented workflow fail at the verification gate.
expectedOutput: Add goal, goal:verify, ship:eval, ship:improve, host:compile, and graph:query scripts to package.json pointing to their existing script files.
Confirm npm run goal -- status exits without error.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Register the missing ship-loop npm scripts in package.json so the documented commands in AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/ship-loop/SKILL.md are executable.

## Validation

- Run npm run goal -- status and confirm it exits cleanly
- Run npm run goal:verify and confirm it executes lint + test

findings.title: Learning capture pipeline has no exercised evidence
findings.reason: The learning-loop script and npm run learn command exist, but the analyzer found zero episode records, zero recurring candidates, and zero normalized events. The coverage boundary reports Capture as not-evaluable due to missing normalized events. Without exercised episodes, repeated work patterns cannot be detected or routed to durable improvements.
expectedOutput: Run npm run learn after completing a bounded task to record one episode.
Confirm npm run learn:status shows the captured episode.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Exercise the learning-loop capture by completing one bounded task and recording its episode. Establish a baseline so future reviews can detect repeated patterns.

## Validation

- Run npm run learn:status and confirm at least one captured episode exists
